meta.title: fix: prevent blocking call in get_live_urls
meta.body_summary: Add asyncio.to_thread to get_live_urls to prevent blocking the event loop; also fix MMR doc selection deduplication and ordering.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added asyncio.to_thread; mmr test failure fixed by maintainer; bot reviews green-lighted but no human perf validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: The PR has a large number of changed lines (13985), primarily due to a merge from dev that brought extensive documentation and cookbook restructuring. The actual performance-related change is only 3 lines in browserbase.py, with small mmr and changelog additions. It is a trivial performance fix embedded in a large merge; the outcome (merged) is consistent because the core change is minimal and low-risk.

review_details.concern_detail: Qodo bot reported test_mmr failure due to UUID mismatch after MMR deduplication change; a human maintainer fixed the test in a follow-up commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent blocking call in get_live_urls by executing client.sessions.debug in a thread using asyncio.to_thread, thus not blocking the event loop.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent-generated fix for async event loop blocking was minimal and correct; the unrelated MMR change caused a test failure that had to be manually corrected, but the core async change merged without issue.

core_change_summary.description: In integrations-service/integrations/utils/integrations/browserbase.py, added import asyncio and wrapped the blocking call client.sessions.debug in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop. Additionally, a fix in agents-api/agents_api/common/utils/mmr.py deduplicates and preserves order in MMR document selection. A subsequent commit fixed the corresponding test.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The PR also includes a large merge from dev that brings extensive documentation restructure and cookbook reorganizations, which are not directly related to the performance fix.
